Hospital LOS, time to flatus, oral intake, and defecation are mentioned as comparable across groups, so I'll indicate no significant differences.

Postoperative ileus isn't explicitly mentioned, so I'll mark that as not reported.

I need to ensure that each data point is extracted as per the article's reporting, without adding prior knowledge. I'll structure the JSON accordingly, making sure to separate the GDFT arms if necessary, but in this case, both GDFT arms are treated together since the focus is on GDFT vs control.

Finally, I'll format everything into a JSON object, ensuring that each field is correctly labeled with the appropriate value and the section from the article where the data was found.
